moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: FIRST EXCHANGE
lines: That is the first exchange! {foe} sent out {foeMon} and {player} answered with {myMon}. Folks, this one is going to be a show.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: Did you see how {myMon} moved? I came to study {foe}, but I am watching {player} instead.

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: A RIVAL WATCHES
lines: So that is how {player} opens. Hmph. I have seen better. ...Okay, not much better.

moments.speaker: futureLeader
moments.title: A FUTURE FOE
lines: I will be facing the winner of this. {myMon} versus {foeMon}... I am taking notes on every move.

moments.speaker: futureOpponent
moments.title: NEXT IN THE BRACKET
lines: Whoever walks away from this meets me next. {foeMon} looks scary, but {myMon} has the nerve.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE HOST WATCHES
lines: {host}: Good opening. Let us see if you can hold that tempo against {foe}.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: LITTLE FAN
lines: Wow! {myMon} is so cool! Is it going to beat {foeMon}? It has to!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: LIVE FROM THE FIELD
lines: {foe} against {player}, {foeMon} against {myMon}! The odds board is flashing. Nobody in this stadium is sitting down.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: WHAT A HIT!
lines: That was a perfect read! {myMon} just hit {foeMon} right where it hurts!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: CRUSHING BLOW
lines: Incredible! {foeMon} is reeling! The crowd is on its feet for {player}!

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: THE RIVAL FLINCHES
lines: Tch. That hit was clean. Do not let it go to your head, {player}.

moments.speaker: futureLeader
moments.title: TAKING NOTES
lines: That type matchup was no accident. I will have to watch out for that move.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: OUCH!
lines: {foeMon} hit {myMon} hard! Hang on, {player}!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE TIDE TURNS
lines: {foe} lands a huge hit! {myMon} is in trouble, and you can hear the stadium hold its breath.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: A WARNING
lines: {host}: That is what a real {foe} attack looks like. Respond or be swept.

moments.speaker: futureOpponent
moments.title: NOT GOOD
lines: If {foeMon} keeps hitting like that, I would rather face {player} later than {foe} now.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: HANGING ON!
lines: {myMon} is down to its last sliver and refuses to fall! Ladies and gentlemen, this is why we watch!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: DO NOT GIVE UP!
lines: Come on, {myMon}! {player} believes in you and so does every person in this stadium!

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: GRUDGING RESPECT
lines: You are still standing? ...Good. I would hate for my rival to lose to anyone but me.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE HOST LEANS IN
lines: {host}: {myMon} should have fallen. It did not. That is the sort of heart this stage was built for.

moments.speaker: futureLeader
moments.title: SPIRIT
lines: I have seen leaders wobble at that kind of HP. {player} grips harder. Respect.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: FIRST BLOOD
lines: {player} takes the first knockout! {foe} will have to rethink everything.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: FIRST BLOOD FOR {FOE}
lines: {foe} draws first blood! {player} has to answer, and fast.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: UNSTOPPABLE
lines: Two in a row! {player} has a rhythm and {foe} cannot break it!

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: LOOK AT THAT
lines: Another one down. ...Fine, {player}. You have my full attention now.

moments.speaker: futureOpponent
moments.title: ALARM BELLS
lines: That is a streak. If {player} reaches me, I will need my best plan.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: {FOE} ROLLS ON
lines: Back to back knockouts from {foe}! {player} is being pushed to the edge!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: THIS IS BAD
lines: They keep falling! Somebody, anybody, stop {foeMon}!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE ODDS SHIFT
lines: {host}: {foe} has the momentum. Now we find out what {player} does under pressure.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: LAST ONE STANDING
lines: {player} is down to {myMon}! One Pokémon left and the whole stadium is on its feet!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: ALL IN
lines: It is all on {myMon} now! {player}, you can do this!

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: I REMEMBER THIS
lines: Last Pokémon... that is exactly where I beat you before. Show me something different.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE HOST STANDS
lines: {host} rises from the champion's seat. "One Pokémon left. This is where legends are made."

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE ACE APPEARS
lines: {foe} is down to the final Pokémon! You can feel the pressure rise!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: ONE MORE!
lines: Just {foeMon} left! Bring it down, {player}!

moments.speaker: futureLeader
moments.title: THE ACE
lines: {foe} always keeps the best for last. I have seen what {foeMon} can do. Be careful.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: A DEEP BREATH
lines: {host}: {foe}'s final Pokémon is the one they trust most. Every great battle comes down to this.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE BAND GLOWS
lines: {myMon} Dynamaxes! The whole stadium is shaking! Can anything stand against that?!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: HUGE!
lines: {myMon} is giant! I felt that in my feet!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: {FOE} GOES BIG
lines: {foe} Dynamaxes {foeMon}! This is the Galar way, and the roar is deafening!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE ANSWER
lines: {host}: Dynamax is a pressure test. Find the opening and strike, {player}.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: NO WAY
lines: That is enormous! Is {player} going to be okay?!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: HALFTIME BUZZ
lines: Turn after turn and nobody blinks! {player} and {foe} are putting on the best match of the season!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: EDGE OF MY SEAT
lines: I cannot look! ...Okay I can look. Go {player}!

moments.speaker: futureOpponent
moments.title: SCOUTING REPORT
lines: {foe} has that switch pattern, {player} reads it every time. This is a battle of minds.

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: HOLD ON
lines: I came to see you lose and I am running out of excuses. Keep going.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: A MARATHON
lines: This one is going long! The stadium clock is ticking and nobody is leaving their seat!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE HOST CHECKS THE CLOCK
lines: {host}: Slow and steady. The longer it goes, the more the crowd decides.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE CROWD TURNS
lines: Listen to that! The whole stadium is chanting for {player}! The favour has swung their way!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: WE ARE WITH YOU
lines: {player}! {player}! {player}! The whole stadium is behind you now!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE CROWD SHIFTS
lines: The mood changes! The stadium leans toward {foe}. {player} will have to win them back.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: UNDERDOG TIME
lines: The crowd is on {foe}'s side now... but I love an underdog, {player}!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: DEAD EVEN
lines: The favour bar is dead even! This stadium cannot decide who to cheer, and neither can I!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: EVEN GROUND
lines: {host}: A match like this is rare. Savour it.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FINISH IT!
lines: {foeMon} is nearly out! Do not let it breathe, {player}!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: ON THE ROPES
lines: {foeMon} is on the ropes! One more clean hit and this one is over!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION SPEAKS
lines: {host}: This is a final. No holding back, no safety net. Give the crowd your absolute best.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION GRINS
lines: {host}: There it is. The last Pokémon. Now we will see what you are really made of.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION IS IMPRESSED
lines: {host}: Still on your feet? I expected nothing less. But I am not done yet.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: ONE LAST POKÉMON!
lines: {foe} is not done! "I refuse to lose here! Go, {foeMon}!"

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: PURE BOND!
lines: The bond between {foe} and {foeMon} is pure! It surges with Mega Evolution power!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: TRANSFORMATION!
lines: {myMon} transforms! That kind of power on this stage is something special!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: THEY CHANT YOUR NAME
lines: Everyone is chanting for {player}! The stands are shaking!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE UNDERDOG
lines: {player} is down on numbers but not on spirit! The stadium loves an underdog!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE HOST SMILES
lines: {host}: Down on Pokémon and still fighting. That is what a challenger looks like.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: CLEAN SWEEP
lines: Three knockouts in a row! {player} is sweeping {foe} off the field!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: FLAWLESS
lines: {host}: Not one of your Pokémon has fallen. That is a performance people will talk about for years.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE SWEEP
lines: {foe} has taken three! The stadium is in shock!

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: AN UNEXPECTED CHEER
lines: Do not get used to it, but... go, {player}!

moments.speaker: futureLeader
moments.title: THAT MOVE!
lines: A hit like that would shake even my team. {player} is the real thing.

moments.speaker: futureOpponent
moments.title: WORRIED GLANCE
lines: Two knockouts for {foe}. I hope I do not meet them in the next round.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: YOUR JOURNEY
lines: I have watched every step of your road through Galar, {player}. Today I find out what it built.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: YOUR JOURNEY
lines: {badges} badges, {wins} battles won. Don't tell me you came all this way just to be polite.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: YOUR JOURNEY
lines: Every challenger thinks the road ends here. I want to see what {player} does when it really counts.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: YOUR JOURNEY
lines: {starter} has been with you since the very beginning. I can tell. You fight like a pair.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: YOUR JOURNEY
lines: I heard {starter} isn't at your side anymore. A trainer carries that with them. Show me what it taught you.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: YOUR JOURNEY
lines: {rivalName} told me about you, you know. Said you never quit. Let's see if that holds up.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: YOUR JOURNEY
lines: A full set of Galar badges and still standing. The crowd has waited a long time for this one.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: YOUR JOURNEY
lines: A full team, every member earned along the way. That is the mark of a real trainer.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: YOUR JOURNEY
lines: So few Pokémon beside you, and still you made it here. That takes nerve.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: YOUR JOURNEY
lines: Win after win after win. Dozens of battles on the road. And I'm the one you were walking toward.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: YOUR JOURNEY
lines: {ace} carries the strength of a hundred battles. I'd like to meet it head on.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: YOUR JOURNEY
lines: No cheering for me today, {player}. I've seen your road. Everyone here is cheering for the story you wrote.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE SAW THIS COMING
lines: Good. Better than I hoped. I knew the road would sharpen you, {player}.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE SAW THIS COMING
lines: This is what a long journey does to a trainer. You don't flinch anymore.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE SAW THIS COMING
lines: Every gym, every rival, every bad night on the road. It's all in how you command {myMon}.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE SAW THIS COMING
lines: {starter} still moves like it did on day one, only faster. Bonds like that don't fade.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE SAW THIS COMING
lines: {rivalName} would be proud to see you here. I might tell them how this goes.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE SAW THIS COMING
lines: Those badges aren't decoration. You earned every one of them, and today it shows.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE SAW THIS COMING
lines: That many wins teaches you rhythm. You have it. I can hear it.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE SAW THIS COMING
lines: A small team, and you wring everything out of it. I respect that.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE SAW THIS COMING
lines: A deep bench and you use all of it. You didn't leave anyone behind on the road.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE SAW THIS COMING
lines: {ace} is stronger than anything I expected to meet today. I'm not complaining.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE SAW THIS COMING
lines: I've fought a lot of challengers. Few brought their whole journey with them. You did.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE SAW THIS COMING
lines: The crowd has gone quiet. They know they are watching something rare.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE ROAD SO FAR
lines: Remember the first gym? You were nervous. Look at you now.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE ROAD SO FAR
lines: {wins} wins to get here. I won't let that be for nothing, and neither will you.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE ROAD SO FAR
lines: I don't hold back, {player}. Not for the Champion's pride, and not for the road you walked.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE ROAD SO FAR
lines: {starter} and you, from the first step to this one. That is a story worth finishing.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE ROAD SO FAR
lines: {rivalName} will hear about this fight, win or lose. They'll want to know how you looked.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE ROAD SO FAR
lines: All those badges, all that time. And now it comes down to this.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE ROAD SO FAR
lines: Tired? You should be. {wins} battles is a lot. And you're still on your feet.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE ROAD SO FAR
lines: Each Pokémon you have left carries the whole journey. I can feel it.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE ROAD SO FAR
lines: {ace} has been through everything with you. It knows it, and so do I.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE ROAD SO FAR
lines: Whatever happens, this is the best fight I've had in years.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE FEELS IT
lines: Don't let that one bother you. It fought for the whole road, and it fought well.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE FEELS IT
lines: A fallen Pokémon is not a lost battle. You taught me that when you stood back up in the gyms.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE FEELS IT
lines: That one gave you everything. Make it count, {player}.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE FEELS IT
lines: Hold on. {starter} is still out there. You've never counted it out, so don't start now.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE FEELS IT
lines: You've lost one before. You know how to keep going. Go on.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE FEELS IT
lines: {rivalName} would tell you not to stop. So I'll say it too.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE FEELS IT
lines: Few Pokémon left, I know. You've been in worse spots on the road.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE FEELS IT
lines: You have plenty behind that one. The whole team stands with you.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE FEELS IT
lines: You've been knocked down before and won anyway. Remember that.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE FEELS IT
lines: The crowd is on its feet for you. Don't hear the ones who doubt.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION FALTERS
lines: Ha. You see that? That's what the journey was for.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION FALTERS
lines: I'm nearly beaten, and I couldn't be happier. Make it a clean finish.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION FALTERS
lines: Is this how it feels to be on the other side? I like it, {player}. You earned it.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION FALTERS
lines: {starter} stood next to you for all of it, and now here we are. Finish this.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION FALTERS
lines: {rivalName} always said you'd get here. They never said you'd get this far.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION FALTERS
lines: Eight badges' worth of lessons, all pointing at this moment.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION FALTERS
lines: {wins} battles built that. Don't doubt it now.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION FALTERS
lines: A small team, and it's about to take down a Champion. Remember that one.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION FALTERS
lines: {ace} is not holding back, and neither am I. Not yet.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION FALTERS
lines: One more good hit, and it all pays off. Let's see it.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE NODS
lines: There it is. That's the hit the whole road was training you for.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE NODS
lines: {myMon} hits like a trainer who knows exactly why they're here.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE NODS
lines: Excellent! Not luck. You've done that a hundred times on the way here.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE NODS
lines: That has {starter}'s fire in it. I'd know that anywhere.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE NODS
lines: {rivalName} should have been here to see that one.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE NODS
lines: You've practised that over {wins} battles. It shows.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE NODS
lines: {ace} just proved why you trusted it for so long.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: HE NODS
lines: The stadium shook. That's the sound of a journey landing.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: EVOLUTION!
lines: WAIT! {myMon} was finished, and it's EVOLVING! Right in the middle of the fight! I have never seen anything like it!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: EVOLUTION!
lines: Look at it glow! It wouldn't go down, it grew up instead! That's my new favourite Pokémon!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: EVOLUTION!
lines: Impossible! It should have fainted, but it's evolved on the spot! The stadium is going absolutely wild!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: EVOLUTION!
lines: It evolved to survive! Did you see that? Did you SEE that?!

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: EVOLUTION!
lines: Seriously? It evolved mid-battle just to stay up?! Of course it did. That's {player} for you.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: EVOLUTION!
lines: A bright light fills the arena! {myMon} has evolved and it is NOT done fighting!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: IT EVOLVES!
lines: No way! {foeMon} should be down, but it's evolving! The challenger's in trouble now!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: IT EVOLVES!
lines: It's glowing! {foe}'s Pokémon evolved right when it needed to! Unreal!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: IT EVOLVES!
lines: Evolution in the middle of the fight! {foeMon} refuses to go down!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: IT EVOLVES!
lines: Ha! That's the strength of a Pokémon that believes in its trainer. Come on, show me what you do next, {player}!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: IT EVOLVES!
lines: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Did that thing just evolve to survive?! This match is wild!

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: IT EVOLVES!
lines: It evolved?! Come on, {player}, don't let that stop you!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: BY A THREAD!
lines: It's hanging on by a thread! A single point of health! How is it still standing?!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: BY A THREAD!
lines: One HP! ONE HP! {foeMon} will not go down!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: BY A THREAD!
lines: That should have been the end, folks, and yet {foeMon} is somehow still up!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: BY A THREAD!
lines: It survived!! Nobody survives that!

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: BY A THREAD!
lines: A thread. That's all it has left. Don't give it a second chance, {player}!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: BY A THREAD!
lines: Well done, {foeMon}! There's the spirit! This is why I love this stage!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: A NEW MOVE!
lines: What was THAT move?! {foeMon} doesn't learn that! It reached beyond its training to stop the sweep!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: A NEW MOVE!
lines: Hold on, that's not in its moves! It just pulled out something new!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: A NEW MOVE!
lines: Unbelievable! {foeMon} dug deeper than anyone knew it could, and that was a move it shouldn't have!

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: A NEW MOVE!
lines: Where did it learn that?! {foe} had a hidden trick ready the whole time!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: A NEW MOVE!
lines: It cheated! It cheated! No, wait, it's just that good!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: A NEW MOVE!
lines: I always say the best trainers have one more trick in their back pocket. {foe} just proved it.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE COMEBACK!
lines: They were on the ropes, and now look! {myMon} has the whole stadium on its feet!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: THE COMEBACK!
lines: Don't count {player} out! Never count {player} out!

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: THE COMEBACK!
lines: I told them. I TOLD them {player} always has one more play.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE COMEBACK!
lines: A comeback for the ages! Down to almost nothing, and still swinging!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: THE COMEBACK!
lines: Come on, {myMon}! You can do it! You can do it!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE COMEBACK!
lines: Now THAT is a comeback. {player}, you're wearing the crowd like a banner out there.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE COMEBACK!
lines: The momentum has completely shifted! The whole arena can feel it!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: THE COMEBACK!
lines: I'm shaking! That's the greatest comeback I've ever seen!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: Go {player}! Go go go!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: Come on, {foe}! Don't let them win!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: {myMon}! {myMon}! {myMon}!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: My cousin trained {foeMon}! Let's go!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: {foe} has trained for years for this!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: I bet everything on {player}!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: I knew {myMon} could do it!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: Please be okay, {myMon}!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: Make it count, {player}!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: Don't give up, {myMon}!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: That {foeMon} is no joke!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: {foe}! You've got this!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: {player} is on fire today!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: {foeMon} has so much heart!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: {myMon}, you're amazing!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: {player} is ahead! Keep the pressure on {foe}!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
